note: recorded is a definition, not a measured value: all 8 rows are specified to be answerable-or-abstainable correctly. See README's Live Eval canary section. Rows are area.evals.cases.CASES' 8 fixed questions -- the held-out set written before any real data was loaded and never used to prompt-engineer web/api/ask.js's SQL-writing model call (tests/test_canary.py proves every id below is one of those case ids).

rows.question: What was the total dollar amount of GLP-1 manufacturer payments in the data, across all program years loaded so far?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS total_usd FROM payments

rows.question: Which physician specialty received the most GLP-1 manufacturer payment dollars?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT physician_specialty, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_usd FROM payments WHERE physician_specialty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY physician_specialty ORDER BY total_usd DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: Which US state had physicians receiving the most GLP-1 manufacturer payment dollars?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT physician_state, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_usd FROM payments WHERE physician_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY physician_state ORDER BY total_usd DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What were total GLP-1 manufacturer payment dollars in the first quarter of 2021?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS total_usd FROM payments WHERE quarter = '2021Q1'

rows.question: What share of GLP-1 manufacturer payment dollars were categorized as Food and Beverage?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE nature_of_payment = 'Food and Beverage') / NULLIF(SUM(amount_usd), 0), 2) AS pct FROM payments

rows.question: How do total payment dollars for semaglutide products compare to tirzepatide products?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT product_generic, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_usd FROM payments WHERE product_generic IN ('semaglutide', 'tirzepatide') GROUP BY product_generic

rows.question: What percentage of matched GLP-1 payment dollars went to manufacturers other than Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE manufacturer NOT ILIKE '%Novo Nordisk%' AND manufacturer NOT ILIKE '%Eli Lilly%') / NULLIF(SUM(amount_usd), 0), 2) AS pct FROM payments

rows.question: How many individual GLP-1 manufacturer payment records are in the data for program year 2021?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM payments WHERE program_year = 2021
